description: Turn text into speech with a Plus voice and get a link to the MP3. Spends the user's prepaid YangOpen credit: 25 credits per 1,000 characters, rounded up to whole credits. The charge is made only when the MP3 is ready, and the answer states what was charged and the balance left. Up to 1,000 characters per call for Vietnamese voices and 400 for the other languages; split longer text at sentence ends. Before a long job, tell the user the cost (characters ÷ 1,000 × 25 credits) and check get_balance. The link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

text.description: The text to read, up to 1,000 characters.

voice.description: A Plus voice id from list_voices with tier "plus", e.g. yo-vn0001.

name: text_to_speech_plus
title: Read text aloud as an MP3 (Plus voices, uses credit)
